text_block_list.text:
One morning, I got a message from
Vivlos asking me to come pick her
up at the dorm—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis~...♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~♡
Big! Sis! Ter!♡ I love you♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As you can see,
it's 'Pampered Cheat Day.'

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos is a clever girl, so despite how she looks,
she usually knows how to act spoiled and chooses her targets wisely...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: She is a big pampered baby deep down, so whenever those feelings burst out—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis♡
Big sii~s, pat my head♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...On rare occasions like this, she becomes
even more spoiled and clingy than usual."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
At home, we call this a 'Spoiled-Rotten Cheat Day'
in more ways than one.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I mean, wouldn't you agree? Vivlos gets to be even more pampered than usual...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because we can spoil Vivlos
plenty too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However... unfortunately,
I have an unavoidable errand after this.
And Cheval ran off, too...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You're the only one I can turn to, Trainer.
Could you look after Vivlos for a little while?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainieee~...♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *staaare...* ♡
choice_data_list: ...W-Want to get a frappe or something?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, really~!?
Thank you~♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No way!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I really don't wanna be
away from you, Trainie... you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yup♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey,
lend me your arm~?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Trainy,
do you... hate me...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Do you... not like
being touched...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu~~♪
So yummy~♪
choice_data_list: (I somehow managed to avoid crossing my arms, but...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Can I have a bite
of yours, Trainie?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Say ahh♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ......Trainy?
choice_data_list: (Of course it turned out like this!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Alright.
You're just not in the mood for that, huh, Trainer-cchi?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll hold back...
Even though I really just wanna be spoiled a lot...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're so important to me, Trainie...
so I can hold back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy~...
I'm a good girl, right...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Fweh?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe,
I somehow won♡

And so, until Verxina came to pick her up...
I simply pampered Vivlos non-stop.
